messages.author: cb65713c504cc909
messages.subject: modify lay-out facet label panels
parts:
Dear all,

I was wondering if it is possible in ggplot2 to:

- merge adjacent facet_labels (of the same factor) which contain the same text (e.g. treatment 1 in example plot below), but keep the facet_labels of factor 4 separately
- remove the space between graph panels and facet labels that belong to the same treatment

cheers and thanks!
ellen





cont_var<-rnorm(n=30) 
cont_var 
factor1<-c("site1","site2","site1","site1","site1","site2","site1","site1","site1","site2","site1","site3","site1","site2","site1","site2","site3","site2","site3","site1","site1","site2","site3","site1","site3","site1","site2","site2","site1","site1") 
factor2<-rep(c("A","B"),each=15) 
 factor3<-c("treatment1","treatment2","treatment3","treatment2","treatment2","treatment1","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment1","treatment2","treatment2","treatment3","treatment3","treatment1","treatment1","treatment2","treatment3","treatment2","treatment1","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment3") 
 factor4<-c("bla1","bla2","bla1","bla1","bla1","bla2","bla1","bla1","bla1","bla2","bla1","bla2","bla1","bla2","bla1","bla2","bla2","bla2","bla2","bla1","bla1","bla2","bla2","bla1","bla2","bla1","bla2","bla2","bla1","bla1") 

 dataset1<-data.frame(cont_var,factor1,factor2,factor3,factor4) 

library(ggplot2) 
ggplot(dataset1,aes(factor1,cont_var))+facet_grid(factor2~factor3+factor4)+geom_point()

messages.author: a3c668b849637905
messages.subject: Re: modify lay-out facet label panels
parts:
Hi,

You can modify manually the gtable,

require(gtable)
g = ggplotGrob(p)
g$layout[4, c("l","r")] = c(4, 6)
grid.draw(g)

etc.

HTH,

b.
